description.narrative: Ghana - Agriculture Project - Credit Activity: the Improvement of Credit Services for On-Farm and Value Chain Investments ("Credit Activity") will support the other Project Activities under the Agriculture Project by facilitating access to credit in the Intervention Zones and assisting the banks to improve their ability to assess, grant and manage agriculture loans. MCC Funding will support the following: (i) Provision of funds for banks, financial NGOs and other eligible financial intermediaries for on-lending to borrowers in the agricultural sector in the Intervention Zones. (ii) Training for rural banks and financial NGOs on credit and management skills consisting of classroom and on-site training throughout the Compact Term. (iii) Establishment of pilot programs intended to speed the flow of credit along the agriculture value chain, such as voucher programs with retail input providers. (iv) Provision of funds, through grants, donations, loans, or other mechanisms, to public or private entities or NGOs, through which financing, both subsidized and at market rates, may be made available directly or by financial intermediaries to borrowers in the agricultural sector and to make financing available for warehouse receipt systems, farmer groups, and agro-processing facilities in Ghana to support development of the Ghanaian agricultural value chain.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.

Prior to any MCC Disbursement for the Credit Activity on or after the commencement of Quarter 2 of Year 5: MiDA has engaged a fiduciary or liquidation agent to manage Program Assets in connection with the Credit Activity remaining at the end of theCompact.

Prior to any MCC Disbursement for the Credit Activity: MiDA has selected and engaged the Agricultural Financial Services and Bank Capacity Building Manager, approved by MCC, or in the event the position is vacated, MiDA is actively recruiting for the position.
